events.description: Walking down a city sidewalk, passing parked taxis, pedestrians, and construction scaffolding.
Crossing the street and walking along the sidewalk beside a SEPTA bus.
Walking past a brick wall, yellow bollards, "The Notary" building, and entering a side street.
Walking down a narrow alleyway/street past parked utility vehicles and garages.
Crossing the street at a crosswalk and walking along the exterior of Philadelphia City Hall.
Walking around the exterior corner of City Hall, crossing the street, and entering a public plaza.
Walking through the plaza, passing a Ferris wheel and wooden holiday market booths.
Walking along the side of the City Hall building, passing the statue of John Christian Bullitt.
Walking past a large Christmas tree and a construction crane/cherry picker on the plaza.
Crossing the street and walking towards one of the archway entrances of City Hall.
Walking through the grand vaulted stone archway/portal of City Hall.
Entering the inner courtyard of City Hall, walking towards and looking at a carousel.
Standing near the carousel and observing its detailed painted figures.
Walking around the inner courtyard of City Hall, passing closed wooden market cabins.
Walking through a stone portal to exit the inner courtyard of City Hall.
Walking along the outer sidewalk/plaza of City Hall past the construction equipment.
Walking back into another arched entrance of City Hall and through its grand hallway.
